$comment: Give every built-in example its own project identity. Three of the five shipped labs carry the project factory's placeholder identity (`project-main` / `New Circuit`) instead of their own, so the title bar shows 'New Circuit' after the user deliberately opened 'Two-Stage Op Amp'.
$shape: Each edit is a REPLACEMENT, so it declares only find/replace and needs no marker: the anchor is consumed, not kept. Every find anchors on the net id at the tail of its own payload document -- net-ui-8, net-contact-gnd1, net-contact-p13 are unique in the artifact, so the three near-identical placeholder identities cannot be confused for one another.
$mechanism: The project factory `function pl(e,t,n='document-main')` takes (id, name) and returns a project whose name is whatever the caller passed. Two callers pass a real name: the New Project command passes 'New Circuit' (which is correct there) and the catalog builder passes nothing extra.

Every example payload was authored as a literal JSON blob. Four of the five name themselves correctly, one (common-source-amplifier) does so under its own id, and one (five-transistor-ota-sky130) carries its own id and a longer lab title. The remaining three -- two-stage-op-amp, current-mirror-loaded-differential-pair, fully-differential-two-stage-op-amp -- kept the placeholder, and the placeholder surfaces in the title bar: `_m({projectName: j.name, ...})` renders `j.name`, which is the project object handed straight to `replaceActiveProject`.
Nothing keys off the literal string: `name === 'New Circuit'` occurs nowhere in the artifact, so renaming these three is a display-and-data fix with no behavioural dependency to preserve.

This repair covers the artifact's stored identity. The path that OWNS the display name when a lab is opened from the catalog (?example=<id> and the Examples panel) is repaired separately in the same manifest, because a stored fix alone would be undone by the next payload that chose a placeholder.

repairs.why: the Current-Mirror-Loaded Differential Pair lab stored the project factory's placeholder identity
the Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp lab stored the project factory's placeholder identity
the Two-Stage Op Amp lab stored the project factory's placeholder identity

the catalog owns the name a lab is shown under, but the id -> project boundary used by ?example=<id> and the Examples panel handed the stored name straight to the title bar, so a placeholder stored in a payload reached the user
